fun e delab => do
  let __do_lift ← Lean.getOptions
  if Lean.Option.get __do_lift Lean.pp.raw = true then do
      let __do_lift ← Lean.getOptions
      have __do_jp : Lean.Expr → Lean.MetaM Lean.Widget.CodeWithInfos := fun e =>
        pure (Lean.Widget.TaggedText.text (toString e))
      if Lean.getPPInstantiateMVars __do_lift = true then do
          let e ← Lean.instantiateMVars e
          __do_jp e
        else do
          let e ← pure e
          __do_jp e
    else do
      let __x ← Lean.PrettyPrinter.ppExprWithInfos e ∅ delab
      match __x with
        | { fmt := fmt, infos := infos } =>
          have tt := Lean.Widget.TaggedText.prettyTagged fmt;
          do
          let __do_lift ← Lean.getEnv
          let __do_lift_1 ← Lean.getMCtx
          let __do_lift_2 ← Lean.getOptions
          let __do_lift_3 ← Lean.getCurrNamespace
          let __do_lift_4 ← Lean.getOpenDecls
          let __do_lift_5 ← Lean.getNGen
          have ctx : Lean.Elab.ContextInfo :=
            { env := __do_lift, fileMap := default, mctx := __do_lift_1, options := __do_lift_2,
              currNamespace := __do_lift_3, openDecls := __do_lift_4, ngen := __do_lift_5 }
          liftM (Lean.Widget.tagCodeInfos ctx infos tt)

value.text:
fun mvarId => do
  let __do_lift ← Lean.getOptions
  have ppAuxDecls : Bool := Lean.Option.get __do_lift Lean.Meta.pp.auxDecls
  let __do_lift ← Lean.getOptions
  have ppImplDetailHyps : Bool := Lean.Option.get __do_lift Lean.Meta.pp.implementationDetailHyps
  Lean.Widget.withGoalCtx mvarId fun lctx mvarDecl =>
      have tactic := mvarDecl.kind.isSyntheticOpaque;
      have pushPending := fun ids type? hyps =>
        if ids.isEmpty = true then pure hyps
        else
          match type? with
          | none => pure hyps
          | some type => Lean.Widget.addInteractiveHypothesisBundle hyps ids type;
      have varNames := #[];
      have prevType? := none;
      have hyps := #[];
      do
      let __s ←
        forIn lctx (varNames, prevType?, hyps) fun localDecl __s =>
            have varNames := __s.1;
            have __s := __s.2;
            have prevType? := __s.1;
            have hyps := __s.2;
            if
                (!ppAuxDecls && localDecl.isAuxDecl ||
                    !ppImplDetailHyps && localDecl.isImplementationDetail) =
                  true then
              pure (ForInStep.yield (varNames, prevType?, hyps))
            else
              match localDecl with
              | Lean.LocalDecl.cdecl _index fvarId varName type bi kind =>
                have varName := toString varName;
                do
                let type ← Lean.instantiateMVars type
                have __do_jp :
                  Unit →
                    Array (String × Lean.FVarId) →
                      Array Lean.Widget.InteractiveHypothesisBundle →
                        Lean.MetaM
                          (ForInStep
                            (Array (String × Lean.FVarId) ×
                              Option Lean.Expr × Array Lean.Widget.InteractiveHypothesisBundle)) :=
                  fun __r varNames hyps =>
                  have prevType? := some type;
                  pure (ForInStep.yield (varNames, prevType?, hyps))
                if (prevType? == none || prevType? == some type) = true then
                    have varNames := varNames.push (varName, fvarId);
                    __do_jp () varNames hyps
                  else do
                    let hyps ← pushPending varNames prevType? hyps
                    have varNames : Array (String × Lean.FVarId) := #[(varName, fvarId)]
                    __do_jp () varNames hyps
              | Lean.LocalDecl.ldecl _index fvarId varName type value true kind =>
                have varName := toString varName;
                do
                let type ← Lean.instantiateMVars type
                have __do_jp :
                  Unit →
                    Array (String × Lean.FVarId) →
                      Array Lean.Widget.InteractiveHypothesisBundle →
                        Lean.MetaM
                          (ForInStep
                            (Array (String × Lean.FVarId) ×
                              Option Lean.Expr × Array Lean.Widget.InteractiveHypothesisBundle)) :=
                  fun __r varNames hyps =>
                  have prevType? := some type;
                  pure (ForInStep.yield (varNames, prevType?, hyps))
                if (prevType? == none || prevType? == some type) = true then
                    have varNames := varNames.push (varName, fvarId);
                    __do_jp () varNames hyps
                  else do
                    let hyps ← pushPending varNames prevType? hyps
                    have varNames : Array (String × Lean.FVarId) := #[(varName, fvarId)]
                    __do_jp () varNames hyps
              | Lean.LocalDecl.ldecl _index fvarId varName type val false kind =>
                have varName := toString varName;
                do
                let hyps ← pushPending varNames prevType? hyps
                let type ← Lean.instantiateMVars type
                let val ← Lean.instantiateMVars val
                let hyps ←
                  Lean.Widget.addInteractiveHypothesisBundle hyps #[(varName, fvarId)] type
                      (some val) tactic
                have varNames : Array (String × Lean.FVarId) := #[]
                have prevType? : Option Lean.Expr := none
                pure (ForInStep.yield (varNames, prevType?, hyps))
      have varNames : Array (String × Lean.FVarId) := __s.1
      have __s : Option Lean.Expr × Array Lean.Widget.InteractiveHypothesisBundle := __s.2
      have prevType? : Option Lean.Expr := __s.1
      have hyps : Array Lean.Widget.InteractiveHypothesisBundle := __s.2
      let hyps ← pushPending varNames prevType? hyps
      let goalTp ← Lean.instantiateMVars mvarDecl.type
      let goalFmt ← Lean.Widget.ppExprTagged goalTp
      have userName? : Option String :=
        match mvarDecl.userName with
        | Lean.Name.anonymous => none
        | name => some (toString name.eraseMacroScopes)
      let __do_lift ← Lean.Elab.CommandContextInfo.save
      let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Server.WithRpcRef.mk { toCommandContextInfo := __do_lift })
      pure
          { hyps := hyps, type := goalFmt, ctx := __do_lift, userName? := userName?,
            goalPrefix := Lean.Meta.getGoalPrefix mvarDecl, mvarId := mvarId }

  let mctx ← Lean.getMCtx
  match mctx.findDecl? goal with
    | some mvarDecl => do
      let __do_lift ← Lean.getOptions

fun hyps ids type value? tactic =>
  have __do_jp := fun __r =>
    have fvarIds := Array.map Prod.snd ids;
    have names := Array.map Prod.fst ids;
    do
    let __do_lift ← Lean.Widget.ppExprTagged type
    let __do_lift_1 ←
      Option.mapM (Lean.Widget.addInteractiveHypothesisBundle.ppLetValueExprTagged✝ tactic) value?
    let __do_lift_2 ← Lean.Meta.isClass? type
    let __do_lift_3 ← Lean.instantiateMVars type
    pure
        (hyps.push
          { names := names, fvarIds := fvarIds, type := __do_lift, val? := __do_lift_1,
            isInstance? := if __do_lift_2.isSome = true then some true else none,
            isType? := if __do_lift_3.isSort = true then some true else none });
  if (ids.size == 0) = true then do
    let __r ←
      Lean.throwError
          (Lean.toMessageData
            "Can only add a nonzero number of ids as an InteractiveHypothesisBundle.")
    __do_jp __r
  else __do_jp ()

fun g userName? goalPrefix =>
  (have indent := 2;
    have ret :=
      match userName? with
      | some userName => Std.format "case " ++ Std.format userName
      | none => Std.Format.nil;
    do
    let __s ←
      forIn g.hyps ret fun hyp __s =>
          have ret := __s;
          have ret := Lean.Widget.InteractiveGoalCore.pretty.addLine✝ ret;
          have names :=
            " ".intercalate
              (List.filter (fun x => x != toString Lean.Name.anonymous) hyp.names.toList);
          match names with
          | "" =>
            have ret :=
              ret ++
                (Std.format ":" ++
                    Std.format
                      (Std.Format.nest indent
                        (Std.Format.line ++
                          Std.Format.text (Lean.Widget.TaggedText.stripTags hyp.type)))).group;
            pure (ForInStep.yield ret)
          | x =>
            match hyp.val? with
            | some val =>
              have ret :=
                ret ++
                  (Std.format names ++ Std.format " : " ++
                          Std.format (Lean.Widget.TaggedText.stripTags hyp.type) ++
                        Std.format " :=" ++
                      Std.format
                        (Std.Format.nest indent
                          (Std.Format.line ++
                            Std.Format.text (Lean.Widget.TaggedText.stripTags val)))).group;
              pure (ForInStep.yield ret)
            | none =>
              have ret :=
                ret ++
                  (Std.format names ++ Std.format " :" ++
                      Std.format
                        (Std.Format.nest indent
                          (Std.Format.line ++
                            Std.Format.text (Lean.Widget.TaggedText.stripTags hyp.type)))).group;
              pure (ForInStep.yield ret)
    have ret : Std.Format := __s
    have ret : Std.Format := Lean.Widget.InteractiveGoalCore.pretty.addLine✝ ret
    ret ++
        (Std.format goalPrefix ++
          Std.format
            (Std.Format.nest indent
              (Std.Format.text (Lean.Widget.TaggedText.stripTags g.type))))).run

fun {m} [Monad m] range tree =>
  Lean.Elab.InfoTree.visitM (fun x x_1 x_2 => pure true)
    (fun x i x_1 results =>
      have results := List.filterMap id (List.filterMap id results);
      match results with
      | results :: tail =>
        match i with
        | Lean.Elab.Info.ofMacroExpansionInfo i => pure (some (i :: results))
        | x => pure (some results)
      | x =>
        if (i.contains range.start && i.contains range.stop true) = true then
          match i with
          | Lean.Elab.Info.ofMacroExpansionInfo i => pure (some [i])
          | x => pure (some [])
        else pure none)
    none tree

doc: Transform a Lean Message concerning the given text into an LSP Diagnostic.

signature.text:
def Lean.Widget.msgToInteractiveDiagnostic (text : Lean.FileMap) (m : Lean.Message)
  (hasWidgets : Bool) : BaseIO Lean.Widget.InteractiveDiagnostic

value.text:
fun text m hasWidgets =>
  have low := text.leanPosToLspPos m.pos;
  have fullHigh := text.leanPosToLspPos (m.endPos.getD m.pos);
  have high :=
    match m.endPos with
    | some endPos =>
      have endPos :=
        if (!m.keepFullRange && decide (endPos.line > m.pos.line)) = true then
          { line := m.pos.line + 1, column := 0 }
        else endPos;
      text.leanPosToLspPos endPos
    | none => low;
  have range := { start := low, «end» := high };
  have fullRange := { start := low, «end» := fullHigh };
  have severity? :=
    some
      (match m.severity with
      | Lean.MessageSeverity.information => Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticSeverity.information
      | Lean.MessageSeverity.warning => Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticSeverity.warning
      | Lean.MessageSeverity.error => Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticSeverity.error);
  have isSilent? := if m.isSilent = true then some true else none;
  have source? := some "Lean 4";
  have tags? :=
    if m.data.isDeprecationWarning = true then some #[Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticTag.deprecated]
    else
      if m.data.isUnusedVariableWarning = true then some #[Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticTag.unnecessary]
      else none;
  have leanTags? :=
    if Lean.MessageData.hasTag (fun x => x == `Tactic.unsolvedGoals) m.data = true then
      some #[Lean.Lsp.LeanDiagnosticTag.unsolvedGoals]
    else
      if Lean.MessageData.hasTag (fun x => x == `goalsAccomplished) m.data = true then
        some #[Lean.Lsp.LeanDiagnosticTag.goalsAccomplished]
      else none;
  do
  let __do_lift ← EIO.toBaseIO (Lean.Widget.msgToInteractive m.data hasWidgets)
  have message : Lean.Widget.InteractiveMessage :=
    match __do_lift with
    | Except.ok msg => msg
    | Except.error ex =>
      Lean.Widget.TaggedText.text
        (toString "[error when printing message: " ++ toString ex.toString ++ toString "]")
  have code? : Option Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticCode :=
    Option.map (fun x => Lean.Lsp.DiagnosticCode.string x.toString) (Lean.errorNameOfKind? m.kind)
  pure
      { range := range, fullRange? := some fullRange, severity? := severity?,
        isSilent? := isSilent?, code? := code?, source? := source?, message := message,
        tags? := tags?, leanTags? := leanTags? }

doc:
Condition variable, a synchronization primitive to be used with a `BaseMutex` or `Mutex`.

The thread that wants to modify the shared variable must:
1. Lock the `BaseMutex` or `Mutex`
2. Work on the shared variable
3. Call `Condvar.notifyOne` or `Condvar.notifyAll` after it is done. Note that this may be done
   before or after the mutex is unlocked.

If working with a `Mutex` the thread that waits on the `Condvar` can use `Mutex.atomicallyOnce`
to wait until a condition is true. If working with a `BaseMutex` it must:
1. Lock the `BaseMutex`.
2. Do one of the following:
  - Use `Condvar.waitUntil` to (potentially repeatedly wait) on the condition variable until
     the condition is true.
  - Implement the waiting manually by:
    1. Checking the condition
    2. Calling `Condvar.wait` which releases the `BaseMutex` and suspends execution until the
       condition variable is notified.
    3. Check the condition and resume waiting if not satisfied.

doc:
Collects diagnostics for a `textDocument/publishDiagnostics` notification, updates
the incremental tracking fields and writes the notification to the client.

When `incrementalDiagnosticSupport` is `true` and the state allows it, sends only
the newly added diagnostics with `isIncremental? := some true`. Otherwise, sends
all sticky and non-sticky diagnostics non-incrementally.

The state update and the write are performed atomically under the diagnostics mutex
to prevent reordering between concurrent publishers (the reporter task and the main thread).

def Lean.Server.FileWorker.EditableDocumentCore.publishDiagnostics
  (doc : Lean.Server.FileWorker.EditableDocumentCore) (incrementalDiagnosticSupport : Bool)
  (writeDiagnostics : Lean.JsonRpc.Notification Lean.Lsp.PublishDiagnosticsParams → BaseIO Unit) :
  BaseIO Unit

value.text:
fun doc incrementalDiagnosticSupport writeDiagnostics =>
  doc.diagnosticsMutex.atomically do
    let ds ← get
    have useIncremental : Bool := incrementalDiagnosticSupport && ds.isIncremental
    let stickyDiags ← ST.Ref.get ds.stickyDiagsRef
    have diags : Lean.PersistentArray Lean.Widget.InteractiveDiagnostic := ds.diags
    have publishedDiagsAmount : ℕ := ds.publishedDiagsAmount
    set
        { stickyDiagsRef := ds.stickyDiagsRef, diags := ds.diags, isIncremental := true,
          publishedDiagsAmount := diags.size }
    match
        if useIncremental = true then
          have newDiags :=
            diags.foldl (fun acc d => acc.push d.toDiagnostic) #[] publishedDiagsAmount;
          (newDiags, true)
        else
          have allDiags := stickyDiags.foldl (fun acc d => acc.push d.toDiagnostic) #[];
          have allDiags := diags.foldl (fun acc d => acc.push d.toDiagnostic) allDiags;
          (allDiags, false) with
      | (diagsToSend, isIncremental) =>
        have isIncremental? :=
          if incrementalDiagnosticSupport = true then some isIncremental else none;
        liftM
          (writeDiagnostics
            (Lean.Server.mkPublishDiagnosticsNotification doc.meta diagsToSend isIncremental?))

fun {α} tree requestedRange init f =>
  tree.foldSnaps init fun snap acc =>
    (match snap.stx? with
      | some stx =>
        match stx.getRangeWithTrailing? true with
        | some range =>
          if (!range.overlaps requestedRange true true) = true then
            pure
              (Lean.Server.ServerTask.pure
                (acc, Lean.Language.SnapshotTree.foldSnaps.Control.proceed false))
          else
            pure
              (Lean.Server.ServerTask.mapCheap
                (fun tree =>
                  (match tree.element.infoTree? with
                    | some infoTree =>
                      have acc :=
                        Lean.Elab.InfoTree.foldInfo
                          (fun ctx i acc =>
                            (match i.range? with
                              | some r =>
                                if (!r.overlaps requestedRange true true) = true then pure acc
                                else pure (f ctx i acc)
                              | x => pure acc).run)
                          acc infoTree;
                      pure (acc, Lean.Language.SnapshotTree.foldSnaps.Control.proceed true)
                    | x =>
                      pure (acc, Lean.Language.SnapshotTree.foldSnaps.Control.proceed true)).run)
                snap.task.asServerTask)
        | x =>
          pure
            (Lean.Server.ServerTask.pure
              (acc, Lean.Language.SnapshotTree.foldSnaps.Control.proceed true))
      | x =>
        pure
          (Lean.Server.ServerTask.pure
            (acc, Lean.Language.SnapshotTree.foldSnaps.Control.proceed false))).run

  [Lean.FromJson paramType] [Lean.ToJson paramType] [Lean.Lsp.FileSource paramType]
  (respType : Type) [Lean.FromJson respType] [Lean.ToJson respType] (stateType : Type)

fun method paramType [Lean.FromJson paramType] [Lean.ToJson paramType]
    [Lean.Lsp.FileSource paramType] respType [Lean.FromJson respType] [Lean.ToJson respType]
    stateType [TypeName stateType] handler onDidChange =>
  do
  let __do_lift ← Lean.initializing
  have __do_jp : Unit → IO Unit := fun __r => do
    let __x ← liftM (Lean.Server.lookupStatefulLspRequestHandler method)
    match __x with
      | some oldHandler =>
        have oldHandle := oldHandler.pureHandle;
        have oldOnDidChange := oldHandler.pureOnDidChange;
        do
        let initState ← Lean.Server.getIOState!✝ method oldHandler.initState stateType
        have handle :
          paramType →
            stateType → Lean.Server.RequestM (Lean.Server.LspResponse respType × stateType) :=
          fun p s => do
          let __x ← oldHandle (Lean.toJson p) (Dynamic.mk s)
          match __x with
            | (r, s) =>
              match
                match r.response? with
                | none => Lean.Json.parse r.serialized
                | some response => Except.ok response with
              | Except.ok response =>
                match Lean.fromJson? response with
                | Except.ok response =>
                  have r := { response := response, isComplete := r.isComplete };
                  do
                  let s ← Lean.Server.getState!✝ method s stateType
                  handler p r s
                | x =>
                  throw
                    (Lean.Server.RequestError.internalError
                      "Failed to convert response of previous request handler when chaining stateful LSP request handlers")
              | x =>
                throw
                  (Lean.Server.RequestError.internalError
                    "Failed to parse response of previous request handler when chaining stateful LSP request handlers")
        have onDidChange :
          Lean.Lsp.DidChangeTextDocumentParams → StateT stateType Lean.Server.RequestM Unit :=
          fun p => do
          let s ← get
          let __x ← liftM ((oldOnDidChange p).run (Dynamic.mk s))
          match __x with
            | (PUnit.unit, s) => do
              let s ← liftM (Lean.Server.getState!✝ method s stateType)
              let __x ← liftM ((onDidChange p).run s)
              match __x with
                | (PUnit.unit, s) => set s
        Lean.Server.overrideStatefulLspRequestHandler✝ method oldHandler.completeness paramType
            respType stateType initState handle onDidChange
      | x =>
        throw
          (IO.userError
            (toString "Failed to chain stateful LSP request handler for '" ++ toString method ++
              toString "': no initial handler registered"))
  if (!__do_lift) = true then do
      let __r ←
        throw
            (IO.userError
              (toString "Failed to chain stateful LSP request handler for '" ++ toString method ++
                toString "': only possible during initialization"))
      __do_jp __r
    else __do_jp ()

Finds the first (in pre-order) snapshot task in `tree` that contains `hoverPos`
(including whitespace) and which contains an info tree, and then returns that info tree,
waiting for any snapshot tasks on the way.
Subtrees that do not contain the position are skipped without forcing their tasks.
If the caller of this function needs the correct snapshot when the cursor is on whitespace,
then this function is likely the wrong one to call, as it simply yields the first snapshot
that contains `hoverPos` in its whitespace, which is not necessarily the correct one
(e.g. it may be indentation-sensitive).

fun text tree hoverPos includeStop =>
  tree.foldSnaps none fun snap x =>
    (match snap.stx? with
      | some stx =>
        match stx.getRangeWithTrailing? true with
        | some range =>
          if (!text.rangeContainsHoverPos range hoverPos includeStop) = true then
            pure
              (Lean.Server.ServerTask.pure
                (none, Lean.Language.SnapshotTree.foldSnaps.Control.proceed false))
          else
            pure
              (Lean.Server.ServerTask.mapCheap
                (fun tree =>
                  (match tree.element.infoTree? with
                    | some infoTree =>

doc:
`stateRef` is synchronized in `registerStatefulLspRequestHandler` by using `lastTaskMutex` to
ensure that stateful request tasks for the same handler are executed sequentially (in order of arrival).

NB: This method may only be called in `initialize` blocks (user or builtin).

A registration consists of:
- a type of JSON-parsable request data `paramType`
- a `FileSource` instance for it so the system knows where to route requests
- a type of JSON-serializable response data `respType`
- an actual `handler` which runs in the `RequestM` monad and is expected
  to produce an asynchronous `RequestTask` which does any waiting/computation
- an optional `serialize` function which can be used to serialize `respType` directly to a string
  for performance reasons, skipping `Json`

A handler task may be cancelled at any time, so it should check the cancellation token when possible
to handle this cooperatively. Any exceptions thrown in a request handler will be reported to the client
as LSP error responses.

  have __do_jp : Unit → IO Unit := fun __r => do
    let __do_lift ← ST.Ref.get Lean.Server.requestHandlers
    have __do_jp : Unit → IO Unit := fun __r =>
      have fileSource := fun j =>
        Except.map Lean.Lsp.fileSource (Lean.Server.parseRequestParams paramType j);
      have handle := fun j => do
        let params ← Lean.Server.RequestM.parseRequestParams paramType j
        let t ← handler params
        pure
            (Lean.Server.ServerTask.mapCheap
              (Except.map fun r =>
                match serialize?, r with
                | some serialize, r =>
                  { response? := none, serialized := serialize r, isComplete := true }

              t);

        rhs.insert method { fileSource := fileSource, handle := handle }
    if __do_lift.contains method = true then do
        let __r ←
          throw
              (IO.userError
                (toString "Failed to register LSP request handler for '" ++ toString method ++
                  toString "': already registered"))
        __do_jp __r
      else __do_jp ()
  if (!__do_lift) = true then do
      let __r ←
        throw
            (IO.userError
              (toString "Failed to register LSP request handler for '" ++ toString method ++
                toString "': only possible during initialization"))

doc:
A request handler is partial if the LSP spec states that the request method implemented by
the handler should be responded to with the full state of the document, but our implementation
of the handler only returns a partial result for the document
(e.g. only for the processed regions of the document, to reduce latency after a `didChange`).
A request handler can only be partial if LSP also specifies a corresponding `refresh`
server-to-client request, e.g. `workspace/inlayHint/refresh` for `textDocument/inlayHint`.
This is necessary because we use the `refresh` request to prompt the client to re-request the
data for a partial request if we returned a partial response for that request in the past,
so that the client eventually converges to a complete set of information for the full document.

fun method completeness paramType [Lean.FromJson paramType] [Lean.Lsp.FileSource paramType] respType
    [Lean.ToJson respType] stateType [TypeName stateType] initState handler onDidChange =>
  do
  let __do_lift ← Lean.initializing
  have __do_jp : Unit → IO Unit := fun __r =>
    have fileSource := fun j =>
      Except.map Lean.Lsp.fileSource (Lean.Server.parseRequestParams paramType j);
    do
    let lastTaskMutex ← liftM (Std.Mutex.new (Lean.Server.ServerTask.pure ()))
    have initState : Dynamic := Dynamic.mk initState
    let stateRef ← liftM (IO.mkRef initState)
    have pureHandle :
      Lean.Json → Dynamic → Lean.Server.RequestM (Lean.Server.SerializedLspResponse × Dynamic) :=
      fun param state => do
      let param ← Lean.Server.RequestM.parseRequestParams paramType param
      let state ← Lean.Server.getState!✝ method state stateType
      let __x ← handler param state
      match __x with
        | (r, state') =>
          have response := Lean.toJson r.response;
          pure
            ({ response? := some response, serialized := response.compress,
                isComplete := r.isComplete },
              Dynamic.mk state')
    have handle :
      Lean.Json →
        Lean.Server.RequestM (Lean.Server.RequestTask Lean.Server.SerializedLspResponse) :=
      fun param =>
      lastTaskMutex.atomically do
        let lastTask ← get
        let requestTask ←
          liftM
              (Lean.Server.RequestM.mapTaskCostly lastTask fun x => do
                let state ← ST.Ref.get stateRef
                let __x ← pureHandle param state
                match __x with
                  | (r, state') => do
                    ST.Ref.set stateRef state'
                    pure r)
        set (Lean.Server.ServerTask.mapCheap (fun x => ()) requestTask)
        pure requestTask
    have pureOnDidChange :
      Lean.Lsp.DidChangeTextDocumentParams → StateT Dynamic Lean.Server.RequestM Unit :=
      fun param => do
      let __do_lift ← get
      let state ← liftM (Lean.Server.getState!✝ method __do_lift stateType)
      let __x ← liftM ((onDidChange param).run state)
      match __x with
        | (PUnit.unit, state') => set (Dynamic.mk state')
    have onDidChange : Lean.Lsp.DidChangeTextDocumentParams → Lean.Server.RequestM Unit :=
      fun param =>
      lastTaskMutex.atomically do
        let lastTask ← get
        let didChangeTask ←
          liftM
              (Lean.Server.RequestM.mapTaskCostly lastTask fun x => do
                let state ← ST.Ref.get stateRef
                let __x ← (pureOnDidChange param).run state
                match __x with
                  | (PUnit.unit, state') => ST.Ref.set stateRef state')
        set (Lean.Server.ServerTask.mapCheap (fun x => ()) didChangeTask)
    ST.Ref.modify Lean.Server.statefulRequestHandlers fun rhs =>
        rhs.insert method
          { fileSource := fileSource, pureHandle := pureHandle, handle := handle,
            pureOnDidChange := pureOnDidChange, onDidChange := onDidChange,
            lastTaskMutex := lastTaskMutex, initState := initState, stateRef := stateRef,
            completeness := completeness }

      let __r ←
        throw
            (IO.userError

                  toString method ++
                toString "': only possible during initialization"))

    else __do_jp ()

                        isPreferred? := __src.isPreferred?, disabled? := __src.disabled?,

fun param => do
  let doc ← Lean.Server.RequestM.readDoc
  match param.data? with
    | some data => do
      let data ← Lean.Server.RequestM.parseRequestParams Lean.Server.CodeActionResolveData data
      have pos : String.Pos.Raw := doc.meta.text.lspPosToUtf8Pos data.params.range.end
      Lean.Server.RequestM.withWaitFindSnap doc (fun s => decide (s.endPos ≥ pos))
          (throw (Lean.Server.RequestError.internalError "snapshot not found")) fun snap => do
          let __do_lift ← ST.Ref.get Lean.Server.builtinCodeActionProviders✝
          have __do_jp :
            Lean.Server.CodeActionProvider → Lean.Server.RequestM Lean.Lsp.CodeAction := fun cap =>
            do
            let cas ← cap data.params snap
            match cas[data.providerResultIndex]? with
              | some ca =>
                match ca.lazy? with
                | some lazy => liftM lazy
                | x => pure param
              | x =>
                throw
                  (Lean.Server.RequestError.internalError
                    (toString "Failed to resolve code action index " ++
                        toString data.providerResultIndex ++
                      toString "."))
          match __do_lift.find? data.providerName with
            | some cap => do
              let cap ← pure cap
              __do_jp cap
            | none => do
              let cap ←
                Lean.Server.RequestM.runCoreM snap
                    (Lean.Server.evalCodeActionProvider✝ data.providerName)
              __do_jp cap
    | x => throw (Lean.Server.RequestError.invalidParams "Expected a data field on CodeAction.")

doc:
A code action provider is a function for providing LSP code actions for an editor.
You can register them with the `@[code_action_provider]` attribute.

This is a low-level interface for making LSP code actions.
This interface can be used to implement the following applications:
- refactoring code: adding underscores to unused variables,
- suggesting imports
- document-level refactoring: removing unused imports, sorting imports, formatting.
- Helper suggestions for working with type holes (`_`)
- Helper suggestions for tactics.

When implementing your own `CodeActionProvider`, we assume that no long-running computations are allowed.
If you need to create a code-action with a long-running computation, you can use the `lazy?` field on `LazyCodeAction`
to perform the computation after the user has clicked on the code action in their editor.

fun params snap => do
  let doc ← Lean.Server.RequestM.readDoc
  have startPos : String.Pos.Raw := doc.meta.text.lspPosToUtf8Pos params.range.start
  have endPos : String.Pos.Raw := doc.meta.text.lspPosToUtf8Pos params.range.end
  have cmds : Array (Lean.Elab.ContextInfo × Lean.Elab.InfoTree) :=
    Lean.Elab.InfoTree.foldInfoTree #[]
      (fun ctx node result =>
        (match node with
          | Lean.Elab.InfoTree.node (Lean.Elab.Info.ofCommandInfo info) children =>
            match (info.stx.getPos? true, info.stx.getTailPos? true) with
            | (some head, some tail) =>
              if (decide (head ≤ endPos) && decide (startPos ≤ tail)) = true then
                result.push (ctx, node)
              else pure result
            | x => result
          | x => result).run)
      snap.infoTree
  have actions : Lean.CodeAction.CommandCodeActions :=
    (Lean.CodeAction.cmdCodeActionExt.getState snap.env).2
  have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := #[]
  let __s ←
    forIn cmds out fun x __s =>
        have out := __s;
        match x with
        | (ctx, node) =>
          match node with
          | Lean.Elab.InfoTree.node (Lean.Elab.Info.ofCommandInfo info) children =>
            have __do_jp := fun __r out => do
              let __s ←
                forIn actions.onAnyCmd out fun act __s =>
                    have out := __s;
                    do
                    let p ←
                      tryCatch
                          (do
                            let __do_lift ← act params snap ctx node
                            have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := out ++ __do_lift
                            pure () out)
                          fun x => pure () out
                    have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := p.2
                    pure (ForInStep.yield out)
              have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := __s
              pure (ForInStep.yield out);
            match actions.onCmd.find? info.stx.getKind with
            | some arr => do
              let __s ←
                forIn arr out fun act __s =>
                    have out := __s;
                    do
                    let p ←
                      tryCatch
                          (do
                            let __do_lift ← act params snap ctx node
                            have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := out ++ __do_lift
                            pure () out)
                          fun x => pure () out
                    have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := p.2
                    pure (ForInStep.yield out)
              have out : Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction := __s
              __do_jp () out
            | x => __do_jp () out
          | x => do
            panicWithPosWithDecl "Lean.Server.CodeActions.Provider"

Find the syntax on which to trigger tactic code actions.
This is a pure syntax pass, without regard to elaboration information.

* `preferred : String.Pos → Bool`: used to select "preferred `tacticSeq`s" based on the cursor


  cursor was indented to align with `baz` then we would select the `bar; baz` sequence instead.

fun params snap =>
  have i := 0;
  do
  let doc ← Lean.Server.RequestM.readDoc
  have msgs : Array Lean.Message := #[]
  let __s ←
    forIn snap.msgLog.toList (i, msgs) fun m __s =>
        have i := __s.1;
        have msgs := __s.2;
        have __do_jp := fun __r msgs =>
          have i := i + 1;
          pure (ForInStep.yield (i, msgs));
        if m.data.isDeprecationWarning = true then
          if h : i < snap.cmdState.messages.toList.length then
            have msgs := msgs.push snap.cmdState.messages.toList[i];
            __do_jp () msgs
          else __do_jp () msgs
        else __do_jp () msgs
  have i : ℕ := __s.1
  have msgs : Array Lean.Message := __s.2
  if msgs.isEmpty = true then pure #[]
    else
      have start := doc.meta.text.lspPosToUtf8Pos params.range.start;
      have stop := doc.meta.text.lspPosToUtf8Pos params.range.end;
      do
      let __s ←
        forIn msgs (none, ()) fun msg __s =>
            have __r := __s;
            match msg.endPos with
            | some endPos =>
              have pos := doc.meta.text.ofPosition msg.pos;
              have endPos' := doc.meta.text.ofPosition endPos;
              if (decide (start ≤ endPos') && decide (pos ≤ stop)) = true then
                match
                  Lean.CodeAction.findInfoTree? Lean.identKind { start := pos, stop := endPos' }
                    none snap.infoTree fun x i =>
                    match i with
                    |
                    Lean.Elab.Info.ofTermInfo
                        { elaborator := Lean.Name.anonymous, stx := stx, lctx := lctx,
                          expectedType? := expectedType?, expr := Lean.Expr.const declName us,
                          isBinder := isBinder, isDisplayableTerm := isDisplayableTerm } =>
                      true
                    | x => false with
                |
                some
                    (ctx,
                      Lean.Elab.InfoTree.node
                        (Lean.Elab.Info.ofTermInfo
                          info@h:{ elaborator := elaborator, stx := stx, lctx := lctx,
                              expectedType? := expectedType?, expr := Lean.Expr.const c us,
                              isBinder := isBinder, isDisplayableTerm := isDisplayableTerm })
                        children) =>
                  if Batteries.machineApplicableDeprecated.isTagged snap.cmdState.env c = true then
                    match Lean.Linter.getDeprecatedNewName snap.cmdState.env c with
                    | some c' =>
                      have eager :=
                        {
                          title :=
                            toString "Replace " ++ toString c ++ toString " with " ++ toString c',
                          kind? := some "quickfix", isPreferred? := some true };
                      pure
                        (ForInStep.done
                          (some
                              #[{ eager := eager,
                                  lazy? :=
                                    some do
                                      let c' ← info.runMetaM ctx (Lean.unresolveNameGlobal c')
                                      have pos : Lean.Lsp.Position :=
                                        doc.meta.text.leanPosToLspPos msg.pos
                                      have endPos' : Lean.Lsp.Position :=
                                        doc.meta.text.leanPosToLspPos endPos
                                      pure
                                          {
                                            toWorkDoneProgressParams :=
                                              eager.toWorkDoneProgressParams,
                                            toPartialResultParams := eager.toPartialResultParams,
                                            title := eager.title, kind? := eager.kind?,
                                            diagnostics? := eager.diagnostics?,
                                            isPreferred? := eager.isPreferred?,
                                            disabled? := eager.disabled?,
                                            edit? :=
                                              some
                                                (Lean.Lsp.WorkspaceEdit.ofTextEdit
                                                  doc.versionedIdentifier
                                                  { range := { start := pos, «end» := endPos' },
                                                    newText := toString c' }),
                                            command? := eager.command?, data? := eager.data? } }],
                            ()))
                    | x => pure (ForInStep.yield (none, ()))
                  else pure (ForInStep.yield (none, ()))
                | x => pure (ForInStep.yield (none, ()))
              else pure (ForInStep.yield (none, ()))
            | x => pure (ForInStep.yield (none, ()))
      have __r : Option (Array Lean.Server.LazyCodeAction) × Unit := __s
      match __r.1 with
        | some r => pure r
        | none => pure #[]

def Batteries.Tactic.Alias.addSide✝ (mp : Bool) (declName : Lean.Name) (declMods : Lean.Elab.Modifiers)

value.text:
fun mp declName declMods thm => do
  Lean.Elab.checkNotAlreadyDeclared declName
  let value ←
    liftM
        (Batteries.Tactic.Alias.mkIffMpApp mp thm.type
          (Lean.mkConst thm.name (List.map Lean.mkLevelParam thm.levelParams)))
  let type ← liftM (Lean.Meta.inferType value)
  liftM
      (Lean.addDecl
        (Lean.Declaration.thmDecl
          { name := declName, levelParams := thm.levelParams, type := type, value := value }))
  have __do_jp : Unit → Lean.Elab.TermElabM Unit := fun __r =>
    have info :=
      if mp = true then Batteries.Tactic.Alias.AliasInfo.forward thm.name
      else Batteries.Tactic.Alias.AliasInfo.reverse thm.name;
    do
    Batteries.Tactic.Alias.setAliasInfo info declName
    Lean.Elab.Term.applyAttributes declName declMods.attrs
    liftM (Batteries.Tactic.Alias.addAliasDocstring declName info)
  match declMods.docString? with
    | some (doc, isVerso) => do
      let __r ← Lean.addDocStringOf isVerso declName (Lean.mkNullNode #[]) doc
      __do_jp __r
    | x => __do_jp ()

doc:
`library_note «my note» /-- documentation -/` creates a library note named `my note`
in the `LibraryNote` namespace, whose content is `/-- documentation -/`.
This can then be cross-referenced using
```
-- See note [some tag]
```
in doc-comments.
You can access the contents using, for example, `#print LibraryNote.my_note`.
(Note: spaces in the name are converted to underscores in the declaration name for
compatibility with the Lean export format.)
Use `#help note "some tag"` to display all notes with the tag `"some tag"` in the infoview.
This command can be imported from Batteries.Tactic.HelpCmd .

Encode a name to be safe for the Lean export format.

The current export format (used by `lean4export` and consumed by external type checkers like
`nanoda_lib`) does not support whitespace in declaration names. Library notes often have
human-readable names with spaces like `«my library note»`, which would produce declarations
like `LibraryNote.«my library note»` that cannot be exported.

This function replaces spaces with underscores to produce export-safe names like
`LibraryNote.my_library_note`.

value.text:
fun n =>
  List.foldl
    (fun acc c =>
      match c with
      | pre.str s => acc.str (s.replace " " "_")
      | pre.num k => acc.num k
      | Lean.Name.anonymous => acc)
    Lean.Name.anonymous n.componentsRev

time. It is stored as a `Duration` since `1970-01-01T00:00:00` in local time, equivalent to a
`PlainDateTime` packed into a single offset, which makes arithmetic straightforward.

`Timestamp` in a timezone yields the `WallTime` (what a clock in that timezone reads at that
instant), and resolving a `WallTime` in a timezone yields the `Timestamp` (the absolute instant the
clock reading refers to).

fun {α} n p =>
  have result := #[];
  do
  let __s ←
    forIn (*...n) result fun x __s =>
        have result := __s;
        do
        let x ← p
        have result : Array α := result.push x
        pure (ForInStep.yield result)
  have result : Array α := __s
  pure result
